POPULATION EFFECTS: The trial enrolled both GD2 positive and negative patients with similar outcomes in each arm, suggesting the mechanism may work regardless of GD2 expression status. 5. CONFOUNDERS: This is a single-arm study with no control group, which limits interpretation. The sample size is small (n=23) and there's no p-value reported for the primary endpoints.
